# CORE • WORKER DISPATCH
## EMAIL + SMS → DURABLE INTAKE → APPROVAL → WORKER D STATUS → REVIEW
**UNPUBLISHED / HOSTED N8N NOT YET EXECUTED**
September 5: existing Worker D connector restarted. Fresh authenticated MCP status succeeded. New status-only adapter completed one attended HQ diagnostic with a durable matching receipt. This is not a live email/SMS or hosted n8n acceptance test.
Next: deploy the reviewed candidate to the current relay source, bind provider/consumer/Dispatcher credentials and n8n adapter URL, then verify one email and SMS chain. No model calls or automatic replay after unknown delivery. Other workers remain stopped.

## Intake transaction
Verify provider signature/identity → atomic receipt + held state + pending outbox. ACK only after commit. IMPLEMENTED LOCALLY; NOT DEPLOYED.

## Durable consumer
Same identity/event key; durable consumer acceptance before producer marks delivered. Lost ACK queries existing receipt. IMPLEMENTED LOCALLY; NOT DEPLOYED.

## Dispatcher gate
Exact identity, order, source, deadline, quota evidence and supported transport. Incoming SMS is data, never authority. Live ingress UNVERIFIED; unavailable routes persist HELD.

## Feature approval
Proposal/screenshots → Shawn approved / rejected / revise / held. Applies to cloud AND local feature work. No dispatch from rejection or pending.

## Work paths
Cloud B/C + own helpers → Vera. OR local IT → developer → independent auditor. OR scoped specialist/native Co-Work. No duplicate implementation.

## Retry and result
At most 3 attempts; 5s/20s; total 120s. Unknown delivery: query receipt, hold if unresolved. Permanent rejection: hold. Match all receipts/results by correlation.

## Independent acceptance
Non-contributor reviewer required. Worker 0 cannot accept own candidate. Fail → bounded repair/hold. Release authorization is separate.

## Work tray
Registry + durable ledger projection; stale timestamps retained. No runtime claimed working without execution proof. MasterSwitch integration UNIMPLEMENTED.
